domain.selector: every stage carrying a non-empty expected_result_image
domain.note: The domain is the set the machine enumerates from the fixture. The counts here are re-derived from it, not carried in. An earlier draft of the plan named 192 images across 53 plans, a true reading of ~/.claude-agent/plans/ taken two plans before the fixture was frozen; if this file and the fixture ever disagree, the fixture wins.

producer.actor: thinker specialization, spawned read-only over the fixture
producer.independence: Not the author of the prefilter these labels score. Briefed with the echo definition only: no detection heuristic, no sentence-position rule, no part of the plan stage this labelling serves. The brief given is committed verbatim beside this file as result_image_echo_labeller_brief.md.
producer.ordering: This file is committed before any prefilter code exists in the tree; the ordering is asserted by a test reading the repository's history, not by anyone's word.

prior.provenance: A reading taken during this task's corpus critique whose per-instance list was never written down. Carried in the plan as an ESTIMATE with its provenance stated, never as a finding.
prior.why_it_differs: The prior counted images that CONTAIN a check-outcome formulation. This labelling counted images that are NOTHING BUT one: the brief's tie-breaker labels an image genuine when deleting its verdict clause still leaves a statement of what the result is. The tie-breaker was authored by the root, is committed in the brief, and matches the stage's approved result image ('merely names the outcome of its check') more closely than the prior did. The gap is therefore largely definitional rather than a refuted measurement.

opens_with_share_below_0.70_of_echoes.consequence_if_fired: the reasoning that made a 0.70 recall floor reachable by a sentence-position prefilter would no longer hold

echo_count_materially_below_the_prior.consequence: prevalence is what sizes the remedy; at 5.5%, concentrated in 2 plan lineages, a hard submission refusal is over-built even if its recall test goes green

decision.decided_by: user, at the stage's own continue-or-stop gate
decision.content: Defect 5 keeps its structural half and its discrimination, and loses its refusal. The prefilter and the fail-open judge run on the submission seam and WARN the author; submission is not refused on an echo verdict. The 0.70 recall floor and the 0.25 false-positive ceiling stay exactly as fixed before the labelling — they are not re-tightened in response to a result, which the stage forbids — and they now govern what the warning fires on rather than what the engine refuses.
decision.rationale: The stage's own refutation names this outcome in advance: a gate whose justifying defect turns out to be rare is over-built even when its recall test is green. At 11 of 200, nine of them three revisions of one plan, the corpus does not justify refusing a submission; it does justify telling the author. The pair of numbers also goes slack at this prevalence (0.25 over 189 genuine permits 47 false positives against 8 true ones), which weakens a refusal far more than it weakens a warning.
